title: Összegzés és gyakorlás: Feltételezések és lehetőségek (Consolidation)
grammar: Review of the past conditional, mixed conditionals, regrets, and hypothetical comparison

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can use bárcsak … volna and kellett volna to talk about the past.
I can link a past condition to a present result.
I can use words like fordulat, kárba veszett and utólag for what happened.
I can say that a choice was good in hindsight.
